name: SwitchBot Lock Pro Matter Enabled (EU)

radios.note: Built-in Wi-Fi plus Bluetooth for close-range unlocking. The CSA listing shows Wi-Fi and Bluetooth.

matter.note: CSA lists a "SwitchBot Lock Pro" from Woan Technology (SwitchBot), certified July 2025 with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. The original Lock Pro has no Wi-Fi and needs a SwitchBot hub for Matter, so this listing fits the Matter Enabled model.

apple_home.note: The product page says it works with Apple Home via Matter, with no SwitchBot hub. Apple Home needs a home hub such as a HomePod or Apple TV.

google_home.note: SwitchBot's setup guide for this model adds it to Google Home with a Matter code; it needs a Google Nest hub.

alexa.note: The product page lists Alexa without saying how it connects. Recorded as Matter because this lock is Matter-certified and no SwitchBot page we found describes a skill route for this model.

smartthings.note: SwitchBot's pages we saw do not mention SmartThings for this model.

home_assistant.note: The product page lists Home Assistant. Home Assistant's SwitchBot Bluetooth docs list the original Lock Pro, not necessarily this variant.

hubRequired.note: This variant has built-in Wi-Fi and Matter; the original SwitchBot Lock Pro (without Matter Enabled) needs a SwitchBot Hub for Matter.

localControl.note: No SwitchBot source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Fits over the existing thumb-turn of Euro profile, UK oval, Swiss round and knob cylinders.

keypad.note: Keypad access needs a separate accessory, sold in the Touch and Vision combos.

power.note: Dual rechargeable AB packs; one keeps powering the lock while the other charges.

summary: SwitchBot Lock Pro Matter Enabled has Wi-Fi and Bluetooth built in and speaks Matter over Wi-Fi, so Apple Home and Google Home pair without a SwitchBot hub. SwitchBot's page also lists Alexa and Home Assistant. It is a retrofit lock that fits over the thumb-turn of Euro profile, UK oval, Swiss round and knob cylinders, and it runs on dual rechargeable battery packs, one charging while the other powers the lock.
caveats: The original SwitchBot Lock Pro has no Wi-Fi and needs a SwitchBot Hub for Matter; this is the Matter Enabled model.
Apple Home needs a home hub such as a HomePod or Apple TV, and Google Home needs a Nest hub.
SwitchBot's page lists Alexa without saying how; we recorded it as Matter.
SwitchBot's pages do not mention SmartThings for this model.
Keypad access needs a separate accessory, sold in the Touch and Vision combos.
